summary.overview: In the recent Business Development and M&A Strategy Discussion meeting, Andrew Day and Ben Treleaven engaged in a comprehensive dialogue covering several critical aspects of their collaboration. The meeting began with personal updates, followed by a detailed overview of Canopy (now Out of Nothing) and Team 11's financials, highlighting a group EBITDA of 6.8 million and revenue of 23.2 million, with a discussion on valuation strategies targeting 8-10x multiples at exit. Ben shared plans to merge smaller companies and to use Team 11 as a pivotal acquisition anchor. They explored business strategies and integration timelines, with Ben set to meet prospective partners in London. Andy outlined his company's sell-side mandate process, emphasizing potential higher valuations and private equity interest. The meeting concluded with discussions on deal structure, documentation processes, and potential collaborations, highlighting action items for Ben to follow up on collaboration and financial modeling.
